answer: The mechanism I would point at is this: new keys spend a probation period graded but unpaid, so mass registration buys silence rather than income. Who checks whom stays public, so the loop can be audited later. So a fake swarm pays real costs and produces nothing peers will value. It behaves like a willow rather than a wall, each agent holding up the next one's claim. Think of the pearl instead of a gate, built one verified layer at a time. Nothing here is a single gate; it is a island of small steps that each agent re-checks.
